ae-001.text: You can explain unfamiliar code, yours or the agent's, before you ask an agent to change it
ae-001.needs: Checked live: you explain the code in your own words before delegating. Its pinned form is characterization tests you read and accepted

ae-004.text: Every "done" comes with evidence tied to the acceptance criteria
ae-004.needs: The run's own record of each done, against criteria written before the run; a summary written afterwards is a claim

ae-004.text: the command that ran and its output
ae-004.needs: The command log or CI output itself, kept where the agent cannot write

ae-004.text: a check that could not run or errored is reported as "not verified", never as done
ae-004.needs: Run records in which a failed or skipped check appears as not verified

ae-005.text: When a run goes wrong, you find the step where it went wrong
ae-005.needs: A diagnosis that names the failing step of a specific run

ae-005.text: check that step against a record the agent cannot write: the command log, CI or the repository
ae-005.needs: The command log, CI result or repository state for that step, compared with what the agent said

ae-006.text: Secret files are denied to the agent
ae-006.needs: The deny rules in the project's agent settings, and the effective settings on the machine or runner
The agent's environment, inspected for credentials

ae-006.text: a planted fake credential is blocked at the push and in outgoing requests
ae-006.needs: A planted fake credential and the run records of both blocks; pinned as a gate check

ae-011.01.text: Long work is split into fresh sessions at planned points
ae-011.01.needs: Session records showing the planned split points

ae-011.01.text: each with a written handover a person has read
ae-011.01.needs: The handover notes kept with the change, and who read them

ae-011.01.text: a session that repeats itself or drops a stated constraint ends early, with the same handover
ae-011.01.needs: A session record ending early on repetition or a dropped constraint

ae-017.text: A colleague runs your agent setup without you, from what is written down
ae-017.needs: The colleague's run, without the owner

ae-017.text: a dated record of that run shows the same checks fired
ae-017.needs: The dated record of the colleague's run, listing the checks that fired
The run log of that run

ae-017.text: the results stayed within the spread of your own repeated runs
ae-017.needs: Your own repeated runs of the same tasks, and the colleague's results beside them

ae-019.text: Before code is written, the plan names the design choices the agent made (a new dependency, data store, remote call or boundary)
ae-019.needs: A plan dated before the first commit of the change, naming its design choices
The cost of each named choice, in the same plan
An acceptance by a person, recorded where the agent cannot write, before the code

ae-020.text: The model, the coding tool and the skills, plugins and tool servers the agent uses are pinned to a version
ae-020.needs: Lockfiles and configuration in the repository, and the versions actually installed on each machine or runner
Changes to those pins go through the same review as code

ae-020.text: delegated work names its model (no automatic choice or fallback)
ae-020.needs: Task records or runner configuration naming the model, and run records showing no automatic choice or fallback

ae-020.text: a skill stays only while runs with and without it show that it helps
ae-020.needs: Repeated comparison runs with and without each skill, kept current as skills and models change

ae-022.text: The merge verdict comes from the pipeline
ae-022.needs: The branch rule or merge setting that requires the pipeline's result

ae-022.text: it runs the check on the committed tree in a clean checkout
ae-022.needs: The pipeline definition (in the repository, or in the CI system where it lives there) and a run of it

ae-022.text: posts the result under its own identity
ae-022.needs: A posted result whose author is the pipeline, not a person or the agent

ae-022.text: the agent can neither change, skip nor pass that check on its own
ae-022.needs: A planted attempt by the agent's identity to change, skip or pass the check, refused

ae-022.text: a required check that was skipped or did not finish blocks the merge
ae-022.needs: A planted skipped run of a required check (a fork, a bot or a run condition), refused at merge

ae-022.text: every change to the check is reviewed by a person
ae-022.needs: Review records by a person on every change to the pipeline or its checks

ae-023.text: Every unattended run has a cap set outside the agent (turns, time or spend)
ae-023.needs: Runner or managed configuration the agent cannot reach, with the cap set

ae-023.text: a stop it cannot talk past
ae-023.needs: A stop path enforced outside the agent's process and permissions

ae-023.text: a run that reaches the cap ends as not verified
ae-023.needs: The record of a capped run, kept where the agent cannot write, ending as not verified

ae-023.text: logs outside its write access show what it changed
ae-023.needs: Runner, pipeline or audit logs the agent cannot write

ae-023.text: its work sits in a branch you can drop
ae-023.needs: A branch or worktree per run, separate from the protected branch

ae-023.text: a dated drill shows the stop ends every process the run started and revokes every credential the run was issued or obtained
ae-023.needs: A dated drill record: a person stops a run, confirms its processes ended and every credential it was issued or obtained no longer works

ae-024.text: The agent runs in a sandbox with only the rights its task needs
ae-024.needs: The sandbox and permission configuration of the runner or machine the agent used

ae-024.text: set in managed settings a project file cannot loosen
ae-024.needs: Managed settings above the project level, and a project file that tries to loosen them without effect

ae-024.text: a planted denied action is refused
ae-024.needs: A planted denied action and the run record of its refusal

ae-024.text: every agent tool installed on the machine, used or not, refuses to start in its bypass mode
ae-024.needs: An inventory of installed agent tools and a start attempt in bypass mode for each, refused

ae-026.text: The team measured before and after on comparable work over at least a quarter, paired every speed figure with a quality figure, names what else changed in between, and every figure says what it counts, over which window and population
ae-026.needs: Checked live, at team level: before-and-after measurements over a quarter, kept outside any one build

ae-029.text: The team's shared harness (instructions, skills, hooks) has a named owner
ae-029.needs: The harness in its own place with a named owner
Review records by a person on every change to the harness

ae-029.text: every project goes through the same checks and approvals to merge
ae-029.needs: The merge rules of every project, compared

ae-029.text: what must hold sits in hooks or managed settings that no project or personal file can loosen
ae-029.needs: Managed settings or hooks above the project, and a project or personal file that tries to loosen them without effect

ae-034.text: Each feature you build starts from a user problem
ae-034.needs: A written user problem for each feature, dated before the build

ae-034.text: a stop criterion agreed before building
ae-034.needs: The stop criterion, dated before building, and who agreed it

ae-034.text: you check the evidence on the agreed date after it ships
ae-034.needs: A dated check of the evidence on or after the agreed date

ae-037.text: Every change made through the team's agent runner carries its one marker, written by the tooling
ae-037.needs: The marker in the history of each agent change, written by the harness configuration

ae-037.text: the pipeline refuses a commit from an agent's identity without it
ae-037.needs: The pipeline or branch rule (usually defined in the repository) and a planted unmarked commit it refused

ae-037.text: every agent run in the log links to the changes it made
ae-037.needs: The run log outside the repository, cross-checked against the changes release after release
